profile.summary: Mentoring in Medicine and Science (MIMS) is an Oakland nonprofit founded in 2006. It works to increase the number of underrepresented health professionals through mentoring, career exposure and leadership development. Its programs include a summer internship, health certification trainings (such as CPR and First Aid), pre-apprenticeships and mentor programs.
